ru.text: Она еще не простила его

en.text: She hasn't forgiven him yet

en.text: Someone beat him very badly

en.text: You need to cross the street and then you'll see it on the left

en.text: He interrupted her when she started talking about politics

en.text: It seems to me that he is right now

en.text: He told me that they had lost the game

en.text: I'm trying to solve this problem now

en.text: I'll try to explain it to you

en.text: As for me, I can't imagine my life without it

en.text: Her heart was beating so fast. She was very nervous

en.text: Don't interrupt me, please!

en.text: When the police came, they were running away

en.text: I mostly ordered it online

en.text: He created this channel several years ago

en.text: I've always respected this kind of views

en.text: I've never said such things

en.text: It's really hard to imagine it

en.text: I've already shared this video with my friends

en.text: I got a very strange message

en.text: Please, don't interrupt me!
